topic: A compilation of failed stunts and flips with a celebrity game countdown overlay.

hook.first_frame: A man in a white t-shirt and black pants in an airport terminal preparing to jump in front of a digital kiosk.

shots.shows: A man attempting a backflip in an airport terminal and failing, landing on his back.
A woman attempting a backflip on a sand dune and failing.
A man jumping on a trampoline and doing a flip into a pool.
A man trying to cross a narrow beam over water and falling in.
A man attempting a balancing trick on a pole and falling over.
A shirtless man balancing on two poles outdoors holding a pose.

ending.last_frame: A shirtless martial artist balancing on two tall poles with a floating face icon in the corner.

retention_tricks: Celebrity elimination game overlay at the top tracking fails
Fast-paced action cuts with fail moments
Sound effect cues for each eliminated celebrity icon
what_makes_it_work: Engaging elimination game overlay matching player icons to video fails
High-energy comedic wipeout and stunt clips
Well-timed sound effects that punctuate each failed attempt
